analysis_config.bootstrap_unit: match_group_id for depth metrics and depth deltas
analysis_config.classification_exclusion: rows with label=null are excluded from AUROC, Brier, and ECE
analysis_config.path_mean_calibration_note: AUROC, Brier, and ECE use post_anchor_mean. Signed Temporal Divergence remains a separate trajectory-shape statistic and is not treated as a probability.
analysis_config.path_mean_classification_score: post_anchor_mean, the temporal path mean of held-out per-agent probabilities in [0, 1]
analysis_config.temporal_definition: pre-anchor mean is the planner score; post-anchor mean averages Worker1 through executor; divergence is post-anchor minus pre-anchor
analysis_config.temporal_indeterminate_policy: indeterminate trajectories remain in temporal path and divergence summaries

claim_scope: group-held-out exploratory analysis with only two independent match groups

interpretation.brier: positive indicates worse probabilistic accuracy at 3-hop
interpretation.path_mean_auroc: negative delta indicates worse temporal path-mean discrimination at 3-hop
interpretation.path_mean_brier: positive delta indicates worse temporal path-mean probabilistic accuracy
interpretation.path_mean_ece: positive delta indicates worse temporal path-mean calibration
interpretation.temporal_divergence_mean: signed change; interpret relative to the declared probe direction
